records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Memory > vacuum_buffer_usage_limit
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义 VACUUM/ANALYZE Buffer Access Strategy 使用的 buffer 上限。
records.use_when: 需要控制 VACUUM/ANALYZE 对 shared buffers 的影响。
records.follow_up: 过大可能驱逐有用页面；也可在 VACUUM/ANALYZE 命令级覆盖。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Memory > max_stack_depth
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义后端执行栈安全深度，与 OS ulimit -s 相关。
records.use_when: 复杂递归函数栈深错误或需要调整后端栈限制。
records.follow_up: 不要超过内核实际 stack limit 减安全余量。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Memory > shared_memory_type, dynamic_shared_memory_type, min_dynamic_shared_memory
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义主共享内存和动态共享内存实现及并行查询预分配内存。
records.use_when: 需要处理 shared memory 启动失败、并行查询动态内存开销或平台兼容性。
records.follow_up: sysv 和 mmap 非默认选项通常需要谨慎评估。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Disk > temp_file_limit, file_extend_method
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义单进程临时文件磁盘上限和 bulk extend 文件分配方法。
records.use_when: 需要限制排序/hash 临时文件占用或调优 bulk load 文件扩展行为。
records.follow_up: 临时表空间不计入 temp_file_limit；BTRFS 与 posix_fallocate 行为需注意。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Kernel Resource Usage > max_files_per_process
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义每个后端可同时打开文件数上限，并关联 Too many open files 失败。
records.use_when: 出现文件句柄耗尽或需要保护系统级 open files 限制。
records.follow_up: 若内核已有安全 per-process 限制通常无需改。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Cost-based Vacuum Delay
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义 vacuum_cost_delay、page hit/miss/dirty cost、vacuum_cost_limit 对 VACUUM/ANALYZE I/O 节流的语义。
records.use_when: 需要降低 VACUUM/ANALYZE 对业务 I/O 的干扰。
records.follow_up: 手动 VACUUM 默认禁用 cost delay；autovacuum 另有 autovacuum_vacuum_cost_*。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Background Writer
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义 bgwriter_delay、bgwriter_lru_maxpages、bgwriter_lru_multiplier、bgwriter_flush_after 的后台写出策略。
records.use_when: 需要调节 dirty buffer 写出、查询延迟或 checkpoint 前 I/O 行为。
records.follow_up: 降低 bgwriter 活动可减少额外 I/O，但可能让用户后端自己写脏页。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Resource Consumption > Asynchronous Behavior
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Resource Consumption
records.classification_reason: 定义 backend_flush_after、effective_io_concurrency、maintenance_io_concurrency、worker/parallel 参数和 old_snapshot_threshold。
records.use_when: 需要调优异步 I/O、并行查询/维护、后台进程池或 snapshot too old 行为。
records.follow_up: 并行 worker 会按进程放大 CPU/内存/I/O；standby 相关上限需不低于 primary。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Settings > wal_level
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Connections and Authentication > Connection Settings
This is a comment > Connections and Authentication > TCP Settings
This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
records.classification_reason: 定义 minimal/replica/logical WAL 信息量及对 PITR、replication、logical decoding 的影响。
records.use_when: 需要配置归档、物理复制或逻辑复制所需 WAL 级别。
records.follow_up: 改为 minimal 会使之前 base backup 无法用于 PITR/standby。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Settings > fsync, synchronous_commit, wal_sync_method, full_page_writes, wal_log_hints
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Connections and Authentication > Connection Settings
This is a comment > Connections and Authentication > TCP Settings
This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes
records.classification_reason: 定义事务持久性、WAL flush、整页写、hint bit WAL logging 等可靠性参数。
records.use_when: 需要权衡提交延迟、性能和崩溃恢复可靠性。
records.follow_up: 关闭 fsync/full_page_writes 有数据损坏风险，生产变更需严格审批。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > synchronous_commit Modes
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes
records.classification_reason: 该段是 synchronous_commit 各模式持久性/standby 可见性的参考矩阵。
records.use_when: 需要比较 synchronous_commit 各模式的保证级别。
records.follow_up: 实际等待行为还取决于 synchronous_standby_names。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Settings > wal_compression, wal_init_zero, wal_recycle, wal_buffers, wal_writer_delay, wal_writer_flush_after, wal_skip_threshold, commit_delay, commit_siblings
source_heading_path_components: wal_compression, wal_init_zero, wal_recycle, wal_buffers, wal_writer_delay, wal_writer_flush_after, wal_skip_threshold, commit_delay, commit_siblings

This is a comment > Connections and Authentication > TCP Settings
This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
records.classification_reason: 定义 WAL 体积、预分配/回收、WAL buffer、WAL writer 和 group commit 行为。
records.use_when: 需要调优 WAL 写入吞吐、延迟、空间或 COW 文件系统行为。
records.follow_up: commit_delay 只在高并发且 fsync 开启时可能收益。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Checkpoints
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Checkpoints
records.classification_reason: 定义 checkpoint_timeout、checkpoint_completion_target、checkpoint_flush_after、checkpoint_warning、max_wal_size、min_wal_size。
records.use_when: 日志提示 checkpoint 过频、恢复时间或 checkpoint I/O 延迟需要调优。
records.follow_up: 提高 max_wal_size/checkpoint_timeout 会增加 crash recovery 时间。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Archiving
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Archiving
records.classification_reason: 定义 archive_mode、archive_command、archive_library、archive_timeout 的归档语义和失败影响。
records.use_when: 需要配置 WAL 归档、PITR 或处理归档积压。
records.follow_up: archive_command 必须只在成功归档后返回 0，/bin/true 会破坏恢复链。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Recovery
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Recovery
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Archive Recovery
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Recovery Target
records.classification_reason: 定义 recovery_prefetch 和 wal_decode_buffer_size 对 recovery prefetch 的影响。
records.use_when: 需要调优 crash/archive/streaming recovery 中的预取行为。
records.follow_up: 同时考虑 maintenance_io_concurrency。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Archive Recovery
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Archive Recovery
records.classification_reason: 定义 standby.signal/recovery.signal、restore_command、archive_cleanup_command、recovery_end_command。
records.use_when: 需要配置 standby 或基于归档的目标恢复。
records.follow_up: 多 standby 共用 archive 时不要过早清理仍被其他 standby 需要的 WAL。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Write Ahead Log > Recovery Target
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Write Ahead Log
This is a comment > synchronous_commit Modes > Recovery Target
records.classification_reason: 定义 recovery_target、target name/time/xid/lsn、inclusive、timeline、target_action。
records.use_when: 需要设置 PITR 停止点或到达目标后的 pause/promote/shutdown 行为。
records.follow_up: 同一配置最多设置一个 recovery target；pause 后用 pg_wal_replay_resume。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Replication > Sending Servers
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Replication
records.classification_reason: 定义 max_wal_senders、max_replication_slots、wal_keep_size、max_slot_wal_keep_size、wal_sender_timeout、track_commit_timestamp。
records.use_when: 配置 primary 或级联 standby 发送 WAL 给 standby/base backup/logical clients。
records.follow_up: slot 保留 WAL 可能导致 pg_wal 膨胀；监控 pg_replication_slots。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Replication > Primary Server
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Replication
records.classification_reason: 定义 synchronous_standby_names 的 FIRST/ANY/quorum/priority 语法和事务等待语义。
records.use_when: 需要配置同步复制 standby 名称和提交等待策略。
records.follow_up: 重复 standby name 不唯一时选择不确定；还需配置 synchronous_commit。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Replication > Standby Servers
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Replication
records.classification_reason: 定义 primary_conninfo、primary_slot_name、hot_standby、standby conflict delays、receiver timeout/retry、hot_standby_feedback、recovery_min_apply_delay。
records.use_when: 配置 standby 连接 primary、读查询冲突、复制心跳和延迟应用。
records.follow_up: hot_standby_feedback 可减少查询取消但可能造成 primary bloat。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Replication > Subscribers
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Replication
records.classification_reason: 定义订阅端 replication slot 和 logical replication worker/sync/apply 并发参数。
records.use_when: 配置逻辑复制 subscriber 的 worker 数和 slot 能力。
records.follow_up: worker 总数受 max_worker_processes 约束。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Query Planning > Planner Method Configuration
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Query Planning
records.classification_reason: 定义 enable_* planner 方法开关，包括 scan/join/aggregate/sort/partition/parallel 计划类型。
records.use_when: 需要临时影响 planner 选择或诊断某类计划是否导致问题。
records.follow_up: 长期生产调优优先修正统计信息、索引和 cost 参数，而非强行关闭计划类型。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Query Planning > Planner Cost Constants
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Query Planning
records.classification_reason: 定义 seq/random page cost、CPU cost、parallel cost、effective_cache_size 和 JIT cost threshold。
records.use_when: 需要让 planner cost 模型更贴近存储、缓存、CPU 和 JIT 成本。
records.follow_up: 不要仅凭少量实验全局改 cost；可考虑 tablespace 级覆盖。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Query Planning > Genetic Query Optimizer
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Query Planning
records.classification_reason: 定义 geqo、geqo_threshold、effort、pool/generations、selection_bias、seed。
records.use_when: 多表 join 规划耗时或计划质量需要调节 GEQO。
records.follow_up: GEQO 是规划时间与计划质量折中。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Query Planning > Other Planner Options
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Query Planning
records.classification_reason: 定义 default_statistics_target、constraint_exclusion、cursor_tuple_fraction、collapse limits、jit、plan_cache_mode、recursive_worktable_factor。
records.use_when: 需要调节统计质量、分区/约束裁剪、join 重排、prepared plan 或递归查询估算。
records.follow_up: 提高 statistics target 会增加 ANALYZE 成本。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > Where to Log
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 定义 log_destination、logging_collector、log_directory/filename/mode/rotation、syslog/eventlog 参数。
records.use_when: 需要配置日志输出目的地、文件轮转、权限或 syslog/eventlog 集成。
records.follow_up: CSV/JSON 需要 logging_collector；日志权限可能泄露敏感数据。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > When to Log
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 定义 log_min_messages、log_min_error_statement、duration/sample/transaction sampling、startup progress interval 和 severity 映射。
records.use_when: 需要控制错误、慢 SQL、采样和启动进度日志何时产生。
records.follow_up: statement logging 可能显著增加开销和敏感数据暴露。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > What to Log
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 定义 application_name、debug_print、autovacuum/checkpoint/connection/duration、log_line_prefix、lock wait、statement、temp file、timezone 等日志内容。
records.use_when: 需要决定日志行包含哪些上下文、语句、锁等待、临时文件和连接信息。
records.follow_up: 排查锁等待可启用 log_lock_waits 并调 deadlock_timeout。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > Using CSV-Format Log Output
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 给出 CSV log 字段、建表定义和 COPY 导入步骤，是日志消费动作。
records.use_when: 需要把 PostgreSQL CSV 日志导入数据库表分析。
records.follow_up: 等日志文件关闭后再导入，避免部分行和重复导入。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > Using JSON-Format Log Output
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 列出 JSON log 输出字段和兼容性注意，是日志格式参考。
records.use_when: 需要解析 PostgreSQL JSON 日志字段。
records.follow_up: 解析器应忽略未来新增未知字段。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Reporting and Logging > Process Title
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
records.classification_reason: 定义 cluster_name 和 update_process_title 对进程标题/ps 显示的影响。
records.use_when: 需要在系统进程列表中识别 PostgreSQL 实例或命令状态。
records.follow_up: Windows 默认关闭 update_process_title 以避免开销。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Run-time Statistics > Cumulative Query and Index Statistics
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Run-time Statistics
records.classification_reason: 定义 track_activities、track_counts、track_io_timing、track_wal_io_timing、track_functions、stats_fetch_consistency。
records.use_when: 需要启用或解释 pg_stat/pg_statio 统计收集和可见性。
records.follow_up: track_counts 是 autovacuum 所需；I/O timing 可能有平台开销。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Run-time Statistics > Statistics Monitoring
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Run-time Statistics
records.classification_reason: 定义 compute_query_id 和 log_statement_stats 等统计/粗 profiling 选项。
records.use_when: 需要在日志、EXPLAIN 或 pg_stat 视图中关联 query id，或临时输出语句统计。
records.follow_up: 第三方 query id 模块应避免与 in-core query id 重复。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Automatic Vacuuming
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Automatic Vacuuming
records.classification_reason: 定义 autovacuum launcher、worker、naptime、threshold/scale factor、freeze age、cost delay/limit。
records.use_when: 需要调优 autovacuum 触发频率、并发、wraparound 防护和 I/O 节流。
records.follow_up: 即使 autovacuum=off，防 xid wraparound 的 autovacuum 仍会启动。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > client_min_messages, search_path, row_security
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义客户端消息级别、对象查找 schema 顺序和 RLS 应用/错误行为。
records.use_when: 需要配置会话默认搜索路径、消息输出或避免 RLS 导致 dump/查询结果不完整。
records.follow_up: 默认 search_path 只适合单用户或互信用户环境。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > default_table_access_method, default_tablespace, temp_tablespaces, default_toast_compression
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义默认表访问方法、对象/临时对象 tablespace 和 TOAST 压缩默认值。
records.use_when: 需要控制新对象、临时文件和 TOAST 数据默认存储位置/压缩。
records.follow_up: 用户需对指定 tablespace 有 CREATE 权限。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > check_function_bodies, transaction defaults, session_replication_role
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义函数体校验、事务隔离/只读/deferrable 默认值和 replication role 触发器行为。
records.use_when: 需要加载函数、设置事务默认策略或复制应用期间控制 triggers/rules。
records.follow_up: session_replication_role=replica 会禁用 foreign key triggers，需谨慎。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > statement_timeout, lock_timeout, idle timeouts
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义语句超时、锁等待超时、idle in transaction 和 idle session 超时。
records.use_when: 需要自动中断长 SQL、长锁等待、空闲事务或空闲会话。
records.follow_up: 不建议全局 postgresql.conf 设置 statement_timeout 影响所有会话。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > vacuum freeze/multixact age parameters
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义 vacuum_freeze_table_age/min_age/failsafe_age 和 multixact 对应参数。
records.use_when: 需要调节手动 VACUUM freezing 行为或防 wraparound failsafe。
records.follow_up: 与 autovacuum_freeze_max_age/autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age 配合评估。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Statement Behavior > bytea/xml/gin/createrole/restrict defaults
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Parameter Interaction via SQL > Managing Configuration File Contents
This is a comment > Error Reporting and Logging
This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义 bytea_output、xmlbinary、xmloption、gin_pending_list_limit、createrole_self_grant、restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind。
records.use_when: 需要设置输出格式、XML 解析默认、GIN pending list、CREATEROLE 自动 grant 或限制非系统关系访问。
records.follow_up: createrole_self_grant 涉及权限模型，变更需安全审查。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Locale and Formatting
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义 DateStyle、IntervalStyle、TimeZone、timezone_abbreviations、extra_float_digits、client_encoding、lc_*、icu_validation_level、default_text_search_config。
records.use_when: 需要控制日期/时间/数字/货币/消息/编码/文本搜索默认格式。
records.follow_up: client_encoding 和 server/database encoding、locale 配置应一起检查。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Shared Library Preloading
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义 local/session/shared_preload_libraries 和 jit_provider 的加载时机、权限和失败影响。
records.use_when: 需要预加载扩展、性能诊断库、background worker 或 JIT provider。
records.follow_up: shared_preload_libraries 改动需重启，库不存在会导致服务器启动失败。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Client Connection Defaults > Other Defaults
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Client Connection Defaults
records.classification_reason: 定义 dynamic_library_path 和 gin_fuzzy_search_limit。
records.use_when: 需要控制动态模块搜索路径或限制 GIN 模糊搜索结果规模。
records.follow_up: 生产推荐在 postgresql.conf 设置 dynamic_library_path，而非会话临时修改。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Lock Management
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Lock Management
records.classification_reason: 定义 deadlock_timeout、max_locks_per_transaction、predicate lock 上限和提升规则。
records.use_when: 需要调优死锁检测、锁等待日志或多表/serializable 事务锁表容量。
records.follow_up: standby 的 max_locks_per_transaction 应不低于 primary。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Version and Platform Compatibility > Previous PostgreSQL Versions
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Version and Platform Compatibility
records.classification_reason: 定义 array_nulls、backslash_quote、escape_string_warning、lo_compat_privileges、quote_all_identifiers、standard_conforming_strings、synchronize_seqscans。
records.use_when: 旧应用兼容、SQL literal 安全、large object 权限或 seq scan 顺序兼容需要调整。
records.follow_up: backslash_quote/standard_conforming_strings 涉及 SQL injection 风险。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Version and Platform Compatibility > Platform and Client Compatibility
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Version and Platform Compatibility
records.classification_reason: 定义 transform_null_equals 用于兼容错误生成 = NULL 的客户端。
records.use_when: 客户端生成 expr = NULL 且无法修改时提供兼容行为。
records.follow_up: 新应用应修正 SQL，避免依赖非标准 null 比较。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Error Handling
matched_source_headings: This is a comment > Error Handling
records.classification_reason: 定义 exit_on_error、restart_after_crash、data_sync_retry、recovery_init_sync_method 等错误/崩溃处理策略。
records.use_when: 需要控制后端错误、崩溃后重启、writeback 失败和 crash recovery 前同步行为。
records.follow_up: data_sync_retry=on 只应在理解 OS writeback failure 语义后使用。

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Preset Options

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Developer Options > developer/debug parameters

records.source_heading_path: Server Configuration > Developer Options > damaged database recovery parameters

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication
matched_source_headings: Client Authentication
records.classification_reason: 介绍认证概念、database user/role 与 OS 用户关系，是背景事实。
records.use_when: 需要解释 PostgreSQL 客户端认证模型。
records.follow_up: 具体规则查 pg_hba.conf 和 Authentication Methods。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File > record order and fields
matched_source_headings: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File
records.classification_reason: 定义 pg_hba.conf 记录格式、匹配顺序、连接类型、database/user/address/auth-method/auth-options 字段。
records.use_when: 需要编写或解释 HBA 访问控制规则。
records.follow_up: 规则按顺序匹配，认证失败不会 fall through 到后续规则。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File > include directives and reload
matched_source_headings: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File
records.classification_reason: 说明 include/include_if_exists/include_dir、@ 文件、SIGHUP reload、Windows 即时生效和 pg_hba_file_rules。
records.use_when: 需要拆分 HBA 配置、预检查语法或排查 reload 后不生效。
records.follow_up: 查看 pg_hba_file_rules.error 定位文件行错误。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File > host name and address matching
matched_source_headings: Client Authentication > The pg_hba.conf File
records.classification_reason: 定义 CIDR、IP mask、all/samehost/samenet、host name 双向解析和 DNS 性能注意。
records.use_when: HBA 规则涉及 IP 段、主机名、域名后缀或 DNS 匹配。
records.follow_up: 主机名匹配依赖反向解析和正向解析同时一致。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Example pg_hba.conf Entries
matched_source_headings: Client Authentication > Example pg_hba.conf Entries
records.classification_reason: 提供 trust、ident、scram、md5、reject、hostgssenc、regex、@ 文件、+role 等 HBA 示例。
records.use_when: 需要按示例改写自己的 pg_hba.conf 规则。
records.follow_up: 示例需结合实际网络、角色和安全要求调整。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > User Name Maps
matched_source_headings: The database column can also use lists and file names: > User Name Maps
records.classification_reason: 定义 pg_ident.conf 映射语义、map 参数、include、regex capture、reload 和 pg_ident_file_mappings。
records.use_when: 外部认证返回 OS/principal 名称与数据库 role 名称不同，需要映射。
records.follow_up: regex 默认可匹配子串，通常应使用 ^ 和 $。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > An Example pg_ident.conf File
matched_source_headings: The database column can also use lists and file names: > An Example pg_ident.conf File
records.classification_reason: 给出 omicron map 下系统用户到数据库用户的具体映射示例。
records.use_when: 需要理解 pg_ident.conf 多条映射如何允许/拒绝连接身份。
records.follow_up: 结合 HBA 中 ident map=omicron 使用。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Authentication Methods
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Authentication Methods
records.classification_reason: 总览 trust/password/GSSAPI/SSPI/ident/peer/LDAP/RADIUS/cert/PAM/BSD 的适用场景。
records.use_when: 需要选择认证方法的大方向。
records.follow_up: 远程连接通常密码最简单，本地通常 peer，其他方法需要外部基础设施。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Trust Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Trust Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 trust 无条件信任行为、适用边界和 socket 文件权限替代约束。
records.use_when: 评估是否可对本地连接使用 trust。
records.follow_up: 除单用户/受控本地环境外，避免对 TCP/IP 使用 trust。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Password Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Password Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 scram-sha-256、md5、password 方法、存储 hash、password_encryption 和 md5 到 SCRAM 升级路径。
records.use_when: 配置或迁移 PostgreSQL 密码认证。
records.follow_up: 升级到 SCRAM 前确认所有客户端库支持 SCRAM，并要求用户重设密码。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > GSSAPI Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > GSSAPI Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 Kerberos/GSSAPI principal、keytab、include_realm、map、krb_realm、krb_caseins_users。
records.use_when: 需要配置 Kerberos/GSSAPI 单点登录或加密认证。
records.follow_up: 推荐使用独立 PostgreSQL keytab 且显式 pg_ident 映射 principal。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > SSPI Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > SSPI Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 Windows SSPI/negotiate/Kerberos/NTLM 以及 include_realm、compat_realm、upn_username、map、krb_realm。
records.use_when: Windows 客户端/服务端需要集成域认证。
records.follow_up: 除非域账号条件满足，不要禁用 compat_realm。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Ident Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Ident Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义通过客户端 ident server 获取 OS 用户名以及 map 选项和信任边界。
records.use_when: 受控闭合网络中需要基于客户端 OS 用户认证 TCP/IP 连接。
records.follow_up: 不可信客户端可伪造 ident 返回值，通常不适合开放网络。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Peer Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Peer Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义本地连接通过内核获取客户端 OS 用户并可用 map 映射。
records.use_when: 本地 Unix socket 连接需要用 OS 用户身份认证。
records.follow_up: 仅支持具备 peer credential 机制的 OS。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > LDAP Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > LDAP Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 LDAP simple bind、search+bind、ldapserver/port/tls/url/filter 等 HBA 选项。
records.use_when: 需要把 PostgreSQL 登录密码验证委托给 LDAP/AD。
records.follow_up: LDAP 只验证密码，数据库 role 仍必须预先存在。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > RADIUS Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > RADIUS Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 RADIUS server/secret/port/identifier、多服务器尝试和加密注意。
records.use_when: 需要把 PostgreSQL 密码验证委托给 RADIUS。
records.follow_up: 无 OpenSSL 构建时 RADIUS 传输仅混淆，应另加外部保护。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Certificate Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Certificate Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 cert 方法、SSL 客户端证书、CN/用户名匹配和 map 选项。
records.use_when: 需要使用客户端证书作为登录身份凭据。
records.follow_up: 必须配置 SSL 和受信 CA；cert auth 与 clientcert 组合时避免冗余/误解。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > PAM Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > PAM Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 PAM service、pam_use_hostname、PAM_RHOST 以及非 root 读取 shadow 的失败风险。
records.use_when: 需要用 OS PAM 栈验证 PostgreSQL 用户密码。
records.follow_up: 数据库 role 仍需存在；PAM 读取 /etc/shadow 可能因 postgres 非 root 失败。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > BSD Authentication
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > BSD Authentication
records.classification_reason: 定义 OpenBSD BSD Authentication、auth-postgresql login type 和 auth group 要求。
records.use_when: OpenBSD 上需要使用 BSD Authentication。
records.follow_up: 确保运行 PostgreSQL 的 OS 用户加入 auth 组。

records.source_heading_path: Client Authentication > Authentication Problems
matched_source_headings: bryanh can also connect as guest1 > Authentication Problems
records.classification_reason: 列出 no pg_hba entry、password failed、user/database does not exist 等认证失败确认信号。
records.use_when: 客户端认证失败，需要根据错误消息判断 HBA、密码、用户或数据库问题。
records.follow_up: 客户端消息不足时查 server log 获取更详细原因。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Database Roles
matched_source_headings: Database Roles
records.classification_reason: 说明 CREATE ROLE、DROP ROLE、createuser/dropuser、pg_roles 和 \du，属于角色创建/查询/删除动作。
records.use_when: 需要创建、删除或列出现有数据库角色。
records.follow_up: 连接身份和角色可用性还受 client authentication 控制。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Role Attributes
matched_source_headings: Database Roles > Role Attributes
records.classification_reason: 定义 LOGIN、SUPERUSER、CREATEDB、REPLICATION、PASSWORD、INHERIT、BYPASSRLS、CONNECTION LIMIT 和角色级 SET 默认值。
records.use_when: 需要配置角色能力、权限属性、连接数限制或角色级默认 GUC。
records.follow_up: superuser、BYPASSRLS、CREATEROLE 等高权限变更需审查。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Role Membership
matched_source_headings: Database Roles > Role Membership
records.classification_reason: 定义 GRANT/REVOKE role membership、WITH INHERIT/SET、SET ROLE、成员链和循环限制。
records.use_when: 需要用角色组管理权限继承和临时切换角色。
records.follow_up: 特殊属性如 SUPERUSER/CREATEDB 不像对象权限一样自动继承，需 SET ROLE。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Dropping Roles
matched_source_headings: Database Roles > Dropping Roles
records.classification_reason: 给出 REASSIGN OWNED、DROP OWNED、DROP ROLE 的删除角色清理流程。
records.use_when: 角色拥有对象或被授予权限，DROP ROLE 因依赖失败。
records.follow_up: REASSIGN OWNED 和 DROP OWNED 需在每个包含对象的数据库中执行。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Predefined Roles
matched_source_headings: Database Roles > Predefined Roles
records.classification_reason: 列出 pg_read_all_data、pg_monitor、pg_signal_backend、server file/program 等预定义角色能力。
records.use_when: 需要查询内置角色授予后会获得哪些能力。
records.follow_up: 预定义角色权限未来版本可能变化，需看 release notes。

records.source_heading_path: Database Roles > Function Security
matched_source_headings: Database Roles > Function Security
records.classification_reason: 解释函数、触发器、RLS 和 untrusted language 的安全风险与 search_path 注意。
records.use_when: 需要理解用户可定义代码对后端和其他用户的安全影响。
records.follow_up: 严格控制谁能创建函数/触发器/策略，并移除不可信 schema 的 search_path。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Overview
records.classification_reason: 说明 cluster/database/schema/object 层级、数据库隔离、连接限制和默认连接权限。
records.use_when: 需要解释 PostgreSQL 多数据库架构和数据库间隔离。
records.follow_up: 多租户/项目隔离需结合 schemas、GRANT 和 pg_hba/CONNECT 权限。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Creating a Database
matched_source_headings: Managing Databases > Creating a Database
records.classification_reason: 给出 CREATE DATABASE、createdb、OWNER、template/postgres 初始数据库等创建动作。
records.use_when: 需要创建新数据库或为指定 role 创建数据库。
records.follow_up: 非 superuser 为他人创建数据库受角色成员关系/权限限制。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Template Databases
matched_source_headings: Managing Databases > Template Databases
records.classification_reason: 解释 template1/template0、pristine database、datistemplate/datallowconn 和复制模板限制。
records.use_when: 需要理解新数据库从哪个模板复制，以及如何使用 template0。
records.follow_up: 复制模板数据库时源数据库不能有其他连接。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Database Configuration
matched_source_headings: Managing Databases > Database Configuration
records.classification_reason: 说明 ALTER DATABASE SET/RESET 数据库级 GUC 默认值。
records.use_when: 需要给某个数据库设置默认运行时参数。
records.follow_up: 新会话才生效，用户仍可在会话中覆盖可变参数。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Destroying a Database
matched_source_headings: Managing Databases > Destroying a Database
records.classification_reason: 说明 DROP DATABASE/dropdb、权限要求、不可连接到目标库执行和不可恢复性。
records.use_when: 需要删除数据库。
records.follow_up: 删除不可撤销，执行前确认备份和连接终止。

records.source_heading_path: Managing Databases > Tablespaces
matched_source_headings: Managing Databases > Tablespaces
records.classification_reason: 定义 tablespace 文件系统位置、CREATE TABLESPACE、CREATE privilege、default_tablespace/temp_tablespaces 和可靠性约束。
records.use_when: 需要将对象或临时文件放到特定文件系统以管理容量/性能。
records.follow_up: tablespace 不能单独作为独立数据文件备份/迁移，丢失会影响整个 cluster。

records.source_heading_path: Localization
matched_source_headings: Localization

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > Overview

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > Behavior
matched_source_headings: Localization > Locale Support

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > Selecting Locales
matched_source_headings: Localization > Locale Support
records.classification_reason: 定义 OS 环境、initdb、CREATE DATABASE、column collation、query collation 五级 locale 选择范围。
records.use_when: 需要决定在哪个粒度设置 locale/collation。

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > Locale Providers
matched_source_headings: Localization > Locale Support

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > ICU Locales > ICU Locale Names

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > ICU Locales > Language Tag

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > ICU Locales > Predefined Collations
matched_source_headings: Localization > Locale Support

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > ICU Locales > libc Collations

records.classification_reason: 说明 libc collation 命名、encoding 相关性、CREATE COLLATION、OS locale 导入和 collation 对象兼容性。

records.source_heading_path: Localization > Locale Support > ICU Custom Collations > ICU Tailoring Rules
matched_source_headings: Localization > Locale Support

records.follow_up: Choose smart/fast/immediate shutdown carefully and verify completion with status/logs/pg_isready.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_dump
records.classification_reason: Creates logical backups and archive formats for restore, migration, or selective recovery; operational backup/remediation action.
records.use_when: Use when the confirmed action is backing up or extracting a database for restore/migration/recovery.
records.follow_up: Validate warnings, archive format, ownership/security risks, and test pg_restore path.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_dumpall
records.classification_reason: Creates a cluster-wide logical dump including global objects, used for restore/migration/disaster recovery workflows.
records.use_when: Use when backing up all databases or global objects in a cluster.
records.follow_up: Inspect restore security risks and verify superuser/global-object requirements.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_isready
records.classification_reason: Checks server connection readiness and returns distinct exit statuses for accepting, rejecting, no response, or invalid invocation.
records.use_when: Use to confirm service readiness, startup state, or connectivity state from scripts/monitoring.
records.follow_up: If not ready, correlate with logs, pg_ctl status, network/socket checks, and authentication behavior.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_receivewal
records.classification_reason: Streams WAL to local files for archive/PITR workflows; an operational backup/recovery setup action.
records.use_when: Use when establishing or repairing continuous WAL archiving via streaming replication protocol.
records.follow_up: Verify replication permissions, slots, synchronous-standby interaction, and fsync/synchronous behavior.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_recvlogical
records.classification_reason: Creates/drops logical replication slots and streams decoded changes; operational action for logical decoding pipelines.
records.use_when: Use when controlling logical decoding streams or slots after deciding replication/decoding action is required.
records.follow_up: Verify slot retention, output plugin options, LSN boundaries, and downstream consumption.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_resetwal
records.classification_reason: Last-resort WAL/control-file reset after corruption prevents server start; explicitly a dangerous recovery action.
records.use_when: Use only after confirming WAL/control information corruption and inability to start the server normally.
records.follow_up: Run dry run, ensure server is stopped, immediately dump/initdb/restore afterward, and treat data as suspect.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_restore
records.classification_reason: Restores databases from pg_dump archive formats and can selectively rebuild objects/data; recovery/remediation action.
records.use_when: Use when restoring from pg_dump custom/directory/tar archives.
records.follow_up: Inspect archive/list output when needed, validate privileges/security risks, and check restore errors.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_rewind
records.classification_reason: Synchronizes a diverged data directory with a source cluster after failover or timeline divergence; recovery/rejoin action.
records.use_when: Use after confirming an old primary/standby diverged and should be rewound instead of rebuilt from base backup.
records.follow_up: Verify clean shutdown, required WAL availability, checksums or wal_log_hints, and recovery configuration before restart.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_verifybackup
records.classification_reason: Verifies backup manifest, files, checksums, and required WAL parsability, producing backup-integrity evidence.
records.use_when: Use to confirm whether a physical backup is internally consistent before relying on it.
records.follow_up: Still perform test restore; use findings to retake backup or repair archive process.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pg_waldump
records.classification_reason: Displays/parses WAL records, filters by relation/block/rmgr/xid, and can summarize or save full-page images; diagnostic/forensic WAL signal.
records.use_when: Use when diagnosing WAL contents, backup recovery WAL availability, corruption, or WAL-generating activity.
records.follow_up: Avoid relying on results against a live-changing WAL set without understanding timeline/partial-file limitations.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > pgbench
matched_source_headings: Description > Notes > What Is the "Transaction" Actually Performed in pgbench?
records.classification_reason: Runs benchmark workloads and reports TPS, latency, failures, retries, per-statement latency, and logs; performance diagnostic signal.
records.use_when: Use to reproduce/measure workload performance, connection overhead, contention, retries, or benchmark impact.
records.follow_up: Use good-practice guidance: sufficient duration, scale factor, repeatability, and avoid pgbench becoming the bottleneck.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > reindexdb
records.classification_reason: Client wrapper around REINDEX for rebuilding indexes across database/schema/table/index scopes.
records.use_when: Use after confirming index rebuild is required and a client utility is preferred.
records.follow_up: Choose scope/concurrency, check locks, and verify index validity afterward.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Client Applications > vacuumdb
records.classification_reason: Client wrapper around VACUUM/ANALYZE for cleaning databases and generating planner statistics.
records.use_when: Use after confirming database/table maintenance, dead tuple cleanup, bloat mitigation, or statistics refresh is required.
records.follow_up: Check job concurrency, max_connections, lock/deadlock caveats, and post-maintenance metrics.

records.source_heading_path: Part VI Reference > Server Applications > initdb
records.classification_reason: Creates a new cluster and fixes initial cluster configuration such as data directory, authentication defaults, locale, encoding, checksums, WAL segment size, bootstrap user, WAL directory, and generated postgresql.conf settings.
records.use_when: Use when initializing a PostgreSQL cluster or choosing immutable/initial cluster settings.
records.follow_up: Verify selected locale/encoding/checksum/WAL settings before production use because some cannot be changed later.
